uk.canvas.decal_place_hint: Click a face to place the decal
uk.canvas.place_hint: Click a plane or face to place the canvas
uk.color.hex_help: Enter #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa; six digits preserve opacity
uk.dialog.no_shown_body: No shown body to change: show one, or choose New Body
uk.help.occurrence.move: Moves an assembly part only along freedoms allowed by its joints. Select a part face, then drag an available arrow or arc.
uk.help.sketch.equation_curve: Draws a curve from formulas: x(t) and y(t), or y = f(x), over a range. The formulas can use parameters and the curve follows them: use it for a sine wave, a spiral or a gear tooth's involute.
uk.joint_move.blocked_hint: Check the joint type (such as Rigid), grounding, joint limits, and parameter-driven values.
uk.joint_move.fixed: This part has no movable joint axis.
uk.joint_move.help: Move — drag an arrow or ring. Esc cancels the current drag.
uk.joint_move.legacy_hint: Turn off to use the previous Move panel.
uk.joint_move.precision: Pull outside the dashed guide for fine rotation.
uk.joint_move.select: Select a face or one assembly part, then choose Move.
uk.joint_move.use_handles: Use joint motion handles for assembly Move
uk.nav.right_drag_orbits.help: Off: a right drag leaves the camera alone and the right button only opens the context menu. Picking the SolidWorks mouse mapping turns it off.
uk.nav.right_drag_orbits.label: Right drag orbits
uk.prefs.auto_operation_note: Feature windows pick Join, New Body or Cut from what the new material touches, until you pick one. Off: they keep the operation they open with.
uk.prefs.browser_show_note: Shown keeps the browser on screen. Reveal on hover keeps it out of sight until the pointer comes over its place or the thin tab at its left edge, and it stays open while the pointer is inside it or a menu from it is open.
uk.prefs.line_drag_draws_one: Press and drag draws one line
uk.prefs.line_drag_draws_one_note: In the Line tool, pressing, dragging and letting go draws one line from the press to the release, and it ends there. Clicks still draw a chain. Off: a drag places a point where it is let go, as a click does.
uk.prefs.project_options_dialog_note: On: choose Geometry or Bodies and Projection Link before projecting. Off: keep the previous direct-pick workflow.
uk.prefs.render_previous_geometry_budget: Use previous Render preview geometry budget
uk.prefs.render_previous_geometry_budget_he: Restore the previous fixed geometry limit (512 MiB on 64-bit desktop, 128 MiB elsewhere) instead of the device-based budget.
uk.prefs.single_surface_analysis_help: When off, surface shading and Continuity can stay on together. Turning this on keeps the last analysis started or changed.
uk.prefs.sketch_align_points: Line up with other sketch points while drawing
uk.prefs.sketch_align_points_note: While drawing, a point lines up horizontally with one sketch point and vertically with another at the same time, with a dotted guide, and the click keeps both alignments. Off: only with the previous point, one axis at a time.
uk.prefs.sketch_state_icons: Sketch icons in the color of their state
uk.prefs.sketch_state_icons_note: In History and the browser, a sketch's icon takes the color of its state (under constrained, fully constrained or conflicting) and its tooltip names the state. Off: every sketch has the same icon.
uk.prefs.stand_up_unknown_note: How the offer is made when the file's header names no program known to save Y up. A note is shown only when the file seems to lie on its back; Ask in a dialog asks about every such file, as before.
uk.prefs.trackpad_zoom_modifier: Zoom with two-finger scroll while holding
uk.prefs.trackpad_zoom_modifier.help: Hold only this key to zoom at the pointer with vertical scroll. Off keeps the existing scroll behaviour.
uk.prefs.zoom_stop_at_model_tip: The 3D mouse and device app zoom toward the surface in the middle of the view; drag-zoom holds the point where the drag began. Off: zoom can pass through the model. Wheel and pinch use Zoom to the cursor separately
uk.render.assign_help: Click to apply to the selection; drag to preview and drop, or click with nothing selected to paint.
uk.render.children.add_look_reason: Add a look to edit its enabled state and strength.
uk.render.children.denoise: Reduce noise in the finished image
uk.render.children.effects_banner: These effects need GPU path tracing. Opening this never changes the method.
uk.render.children.enable_adaptive: Enable independent pilots to edit the adaptive limits.
uk.render.children.enable_bloom: Enable bloom to edit its strength, threshold and radius.
uk.render.children.needs_cpu: Needs CPU ray tracing. Opening this never changes the method.
uk.render.children.progressive_reason: Choose Progressive to edit its sample count and seed.
uk.render.choose_look: Choose a look in Appearances first
uk.render.light_backend_limit: Choose CPU ray tracing or an explicit GPU studio to edit lights. Legacy GPU studio lights remain read-only.
uk.render.light_gpu_punctual: Point and Spot lights are available with CPU ray tracing.
uk.render.light_hard_shadow: This light has hard shadows; emitter softness is unavailable.
uk.render.light_missing: This light no longer exists. Select a light in the Browser.
uk.render.light_place_pending: Highlight placement needs viewport light picking and is not supported yet.
uk.render.light_preview_help: Live view is unshadowed; Area lights use a centre-sample approximation. Render uses the complete light model.
uk.render.light_temperature_help: Approximate blackbody tint; saved as linear RGB.
uk.render.light_view_only: Solo and mute affect this view and its renders; they are never saved in the design.
uk.render.lighting_budget_help: Counts are read-only. Add, duplicate or delete lights to change them; the method sets the limits.
uk.render.lighting_consent: Replace the directional lights with this preset
uk.render.lighting_custom_help: Choosing Custom turns the preset into editable lights, one row each in the tree.
uk.render.lighting_direction_help: Or type a direction toward the light (X Y Z).
uk.render.lighting_falloff_help: Intensity is quoted at the reference distance.
uk.render.lighting_preset_cpu: Directional studio presets require CPU ray tracing. GPU lighting uses explicit Sun and Area lights.
uk.render.lighting_review_help: Replaces the directional light list. Keeps point and area lights, environment, shadows, camera and all other shot settings.
uk.render.lighting_samples_cpu: Area-light samples apply to CPU ray tracing.
uk.render.lighting_samples_need_area: Add a CPU area light to set area samples.
uk.render.lighting_shadow_cpu: The shadow switch requires CPU ray tracing. GPU path tracing always casts shadows.
uk.render.lighting_spot_preserved: This point light retains its saved spot cone until its type is changed.
uk.render.lighting_sun_distance: Sun direction is independent of distance and aim point.
uk.render.output_size_limit: {method}: up to {dimension} px per side and {pixels} pixels. Largest fitting size: {width} × {height}.
uk.render.pick_up_prompt: Click an object to pick up its look
uk.render.scene_batch_reason: All shots needs the saved-shot render queue, which is not available yet.
uk.render.scene_check_stale: Check out of date · check again
uk.render.scene_reminder: Scene preserves the design. Geometry, engineering properties and CAD are never changed from Render.
uk.render.shot_exposure_reason: Exposure needs CPU ray tracing or GPU path tracing.
uk.render.shot_fov_reason: Field of view needs perspective projection.
uk.render.shot_invalid_camera: Camera values must be finite and within range.
uk.render.shot_lens_enable_reason: Enable depth of field to edit aperture and focus distance.
uk.render.shot_lens_gpu_reason: Depth of field needs GPU path tracing.
uk.render.shot_lens_perspective_reason: Depth of field needs perspective projection.
uk.render.shot_selection_reason: Select a body or face to aim at.
uk.settings.insert_lists_open_designs: Insert Design lists the designs open in other tabs first
uk.sketch.dimension_added_driven: The sketch already determines that dimension, so it was added as a driven (reference) dimension
uk.status.navigation_tip: How the mouse moves the view. Click to choose another mapping
uk.timeline.edited_rolled_back: {name} changed, but it is after the history marker, so it is not built: move the marker past it to see the result
uk.timeline.feature_rolled_back: Rolled back: after the history marker, so not built
uk.ui.3d_mouse_orbit_tip: Traced: the 3D mouse turns the view around the part of the model in the middle of the view when the turn begins, marked by a faint ball. Classic: around the view's centre
uk.ui.center_arc_follows_cursor: Center point arc follows the cursor's direction
uk.ui.center_arc_follows_cursor_tip: A center point arc runs clockwise or counter-clockwise the way the cursor goes round its center. Off: always counter-clockwise from the start.
uk.ui.equation_note: The variable is a plain number: sin(t) takes it in radians. A result without a unit is in the design's unit.
uk.ui.insert_design.saved_file: {name} has unsaved changes, so its saved file was inserted. Save it, then Update Links to bring the changes in.
uk.ui.properties.inertia_note: About the center of mass, in world axes (g·{unit}²)
uk.ui.properties.inertia_unavailable: Not available: a body's mesh does not close.
uk.ui.toolbar_tabs_hidden: Every toolbar tab is hidden. Click + or right-click here to show one.
uk.update.prefs_managed: This is SolidCraft {version}, managed by {manager}. A check asks GitHub for the latest release and sends nothing else; update SolidCraft in {manager}.
uk.update.refresh_fallback: Could not check for a newer release; updating to {version}, found earlier.
